Reform Department)

column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹13.69 lakh
was attributed to need of
additional amounts in
Land acquisition for the
construction of approach
road in Parsauni
Mahadalit Tola under
Sheohar district in
compliance of the
Hon'ble court order in
light of CWJC No.
1105/2023. Reasons for
final saving have not
been intimated (July
2024).
